mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over 3 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, indicating tight monetary conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also decline, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative growth for 2 quarters and RSAFS declines
failure_condition: If GDPC1 shows negative growth for 2 quarters and RSAFS declines, but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.
